summary: Alpha Tau Medical Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the first treatment of a recurrent glioblastoma patient outside the United States at Hadassah University Medical Center in Israel. No sale, merger, acquisition, or capital restructuring is involved. The filing is a routine operational progress report on clinical application of its Alpha DaRT therapy. There are no deal terms, board recommendations, or advisors mentioned. This is an ordinary business update, not a special situation.
